title: It’s A Wonderful Life! at Irish Rep #itsawonderfullife #irishrep #rad...
transcript: The 1946 film It's A Wonderful Life is hitting the stage at Irish Repertory Theatre. Framed as a radio production where you're part of the live studio audience, six performers tell the story of George Bailey and his well-needed guardian angel. It's a cliché, careful-what-you-wish-for story with an exaggerated style of acting and singing that isn't generally my cup of tea. That said, it's corny by design, to the point where it becomes sufficiently charming, helped by the live radio commercials and the practical sound effects. Some of the actors, such as Leenya Rideout, lean into their multiplicity of roles a bit more playfully than others, but everyone's fully committed to the nostalgia train that is this show. And at a short and sweet 70 minutes, this would be a great show to bring your kids to, or if you're just looking for something a little festive. With that, another program for my collection.
